_doc: The asset seam: the ONLY place a visual ID maps to a file. Each entry is {"path": real art, "placeholder": stand-in}, plus any fields the consumer needs. See PLAN.md 5.3.

vis.tiles.material_atlas._doc: One seamless cell per tile type, plus thruster nozzles tinted by type. R = detail, G = untinted trim (PLAN.md 6.2). Real art: A.1.

vis.fx.thrusters._doc: Thruster exhaust (PLAN.md 3.6), drawn in code with particles; no files. level_scale multiplies the size per level (L1-3). Colours run hot core -> fading edge.

vis.fx.explosion._doc: A ship's death (PLAN.md 4.2), drawn in code; no files. A white flash, an expanding ring and a burst of sparks, sized by the ship. Colours run hot -> cooling.
